about: Cherrygrove's EV/IV trainer, from the start of the game: the player (route29-official.sav's Modest Chikorita at Lv. 5, no EVs, given 30000 for the fee) walks to her in the Pokemon Center, chooses Train a Pokemon, Chikorita in the party menu, the Sets page (SELECT twice), konefr's Special (4 HP / 252 Sp. Atk / 252 Speed, DOWN), Apply, Done (START) and YES: the fee is 1 + 26 + 26 started tens of EVs, 26500, paid; the EVs are written and the stats worked out again (Speed 9 to 13, Sp. Atk 11 to 14); then back to the party menu, CANCEL, and her goodbye.
